17 * 23

I can break this down:
17 * 23 = 17 * (20 + 3) = 17 * 20 + 17 * 3 = 340 + 51 = 391

Let me verify:
17 * 23
= (10 + 7) * 23
= 10 * 23 + 7 * 23
= 230 + 161
= 391

Yes, 391 iscorrect.
